name: Emaar Misr for Development S.A.E.
source: Emaar Misr for Development Company interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (Ernst and Young review report, translated from Arabic), consolidated statement of profit or loss, EGP: revenue 11,079,067,644; cost of revenue 4,956,395,964; gross profit 6,122,671,680; profit for the period before income tax 7,199,726,126; income tax 1,643,824,028; profit for the period 5,555,902,098 all attributable to the parent; basic and diluted earnings per share 0.96. The pre tax figure reconciles exactly from the printed lines: gross profit less selling and marketing 356,858,956 less general and administrative 1,578,604,172 plus finance income 2,646,121,080 less finance cost 134,801,065 plus associate profit share 32,154,224 less other expenses 44,903,956 plus other income 286,252,596 plus expected credit loss reversal 274,158,791 less provisions 58,882,484 plus provisions no longer required 12,418,388 equals 7,199,726,126. CRON 20261025: the H1 column previously carried the SEPARATE (standalone) net profit 5,123,906,380 and standalone EPS 0.89 beside consolidated annual years; replaced with the consolidated figures. Operating expenses, EBIT and net finance costs stay empty because the issuer prints no operating profit line and those rows were already empty for every year in this file.
